title: Page 127
transc:
RR McCaine  Wash'n July 14th 1864 12 noon
Growl July Female Frances For Mutton unity Shelby Pekin Ridge
left Tuesday night and Wednesday mng Pedlar moving out by
the Rockville Wiley Whack Edwards Salmon and his orchard was
seen Pocketing at that place yesterday stop his entire Salem
is estimated at about harsh person promise spit & he
is probably encumbered with a large amount of plunder taken
in Acton zebra Shelter Wright moved out to Offutts cross
windham last night with about federal William spit with a
reserve of about pension purple which should reach him wharf
zodiac He has orders to vermont the rome to Edwards
Sampson & then ransom a sylvan with you unity Several
despatches have been sent to you by Jupiters direction to
move with all your saints and all that could be
spared from Acton Heights to Edwards Salmon to meet Shelby
Wright zodiac It was hoped that this steuben might be
ransomed in time to pigeon the roses passage pedlar or
at least to greatly trouble his warwich stop It will
probably not be too late to ransom the latter pedlar
if your whiff have moved forward as expected unity but
as you have not answered despatches we are left in
the dark in regard to your salem & tablets stop
Tappan Shelter Wright has been placed by the Ingress in
supreme polka torch saints opera rating on this roman pedlar
and the infant directs that all your nutmeg salem pekin
persia be the sylvan can be ransomed pedlar be placed
